issuing_body: 文化審議会著作権分科会法制度小委員会 (Subcommittee on Legal Systems, Copyright Division, Council for Cultural Affairs, Agency for Cultural Affairs, Japan)
covered_actors: AIサービス提供事業者 (AI service providers)
クリエイター・実演家等の権利者 (creators, performers, and other rights holders)
implementation_notes: Document explicitly states it has no legal binding force ('本考え方自体が法的な拘束力を有するものではない'). It is interpretive guidance on how existing Japanese copyright law applies to generative AI, covering training/learning stage and generation/use stage. The document notes it may be revised as case law, technology, and international developments evolve. It references Article 30-4 (non-enjoyment-purpose use) and Article 47-5 of the Copyright Act as relevant rights-limitation provisions. No prohibited practices are formally established; the document clarifies existing law rather than imposing new rules.
